## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes, why it is needed, and any architectural considerations.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Refactor

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and standards of this project (`ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .`).
- [ ] I have added type annotations compatible with `mypy --strict`.
- [ ] I have added tests covering the new functionality or regression fix.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass (`uv run pytest --cov=smartroute`).
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, docstrings) has been updated accordingly.
